title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #110 · 매체 믹스 · 동심원·매끈 · 4영역(팝아트 코믹+사이아노타입+UV 네온+옵아트 체커보드) · 풀커버 · hourglass bombshell · 정면 한 손 허리 · Indian · 배경 인도 궁전 안뜰 · 데코라
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, sleek slicked-back balayage hair — her body is painted in 4 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 58% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 36%, 64% and 85% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries pop-art comic panels with bold black outlines, flat red, yellow and blue shapes and big speech bursts. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries deep Prussian-blue cyanotype prints with white fern and leaf silhouettes. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries fluorescent UV neon paint in neon pink and acid lime lightning streaks, glowing intensely with a blacklight shimmer. Region 4 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries black-and-white op-art checkerboard distorted into a bulging optical illusion. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, one hand resting on her waist and the other hand relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy soft pink leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in soft pink lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart shapes painted on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows tanning oil sheen, golden bronzed glistening skin.

Background: a sunlit Indian palace courtyard of pale sandstone with carved arches of standard height, low steps and a waist-high jali screen, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
